title: Decide README-ZH localized documentation policy
description: Phase 1 translation is operationally clean, but README-ZH.md intentionally remains Chinese as a localized README. Decide whether to keep it, convert it to English, or remove it.
acceptance_criteria: Decision is recorded in Beads notes and any resulting doc action is either completed or represented by a follow-up bead.
notes:
Kept open as a separate Phase 1 documentation decision. Unparenting it from `auto-company-3hp` so the completed authoritative-state Phase 2 epic can close cleanly without overriding an unrelated open decision.
Decision: keep README-ZH.md as the maintained Chinese localized README, with README.md as the canonical operational source when documentation drift must be resolved. Doc action completed: added explicit policy text to README.md, README-ZH.md, and INDEX.md. Reviewer verification: git diff --check -- README.md README-ZH.md INDEX.md; python3 scripts/core/render-consensus.py --output memories/consensus.md. No follow-up bead required.
close_reason: Decided to keep README-ZH.md as the maintained Chinese localization and documented the canonical-vs-localized README policy in repo docs

title: Integrate Matters and Beads as authoritative state
description: Replace memories/consensus.md as authoritative state with Matters for durable strategic state and Beads for tactical operational work. consensus.md should become a generated human-readable briefing.
acceptance_criteria: Architecture is designed and implemented in small steps; worker agents update Beads; Matters updates are restricted to reconciler/reviewer evidence; consensus.md is generated from authoritative state.
notes:
Beads initialized for this fork on 2026-06-10. Initial operational backlog created: README-ZH policy decision, minimal Matters+Beads design, and three implementation follow-ups blocked by the design bead.
Completed the first authoritative-state slice: seeded .matters/auto-company.json, generated memories/consensus.md from authoritative state, added the Matters-to-Beads reconciler, and wired the loop to matter-scoped bead batches. Reviewer evidence: bash -n scripts/core/*.sh scripts/macos/*.sh scripts/wsl/*.sh, uv run --with pytest python -m pytest, make help. Remaining open child is auto-company-1vs, which is a separate Phase 1 documentation decision.
2026-06-10 coder/reviewer run: no ready Phase 2 work remained. Evidence: bd ready --json returned only the open Phase 1 README-ZH decision auto-company-1vs; python3 scripts/core/reconcile-matters-beads.py --json returned no selected matter, no false conditions, and no ready beads; .matters/auto-company.json shows all authoritative-state migration conditions already true. No code changes were required.
close_reason: Authoritative-state migration implemented and reviewer-verified; remaining README-ZH decision is tracked separately in auto-company-1vs

title: Design smallest useful Matters + Beads integration
description: Inspect the translated repo and propose the smallest useful integration for matters.global and bd before rewriting the auto-loop.
acceptance_criteria: Proposal identifies current state flow, available matters/bd commands, proposed files, authoritative data boundaries, scheduler changes, guardrails, and first implementation slice.
notes:
Design completed in docs/cto/matters-beads-integration-design.md. It documents current consensus-driven flow, available matters/bd commands, authority boundaries, proposed files, scheduler stages, guardrails, risks, and the first implementation slice.
Revision after user feedback: scheduler design changed from single-bead execution to matter-scoped batch execution. Each run selects one actionable matter/frontier item, reconciles its false actionable conditions into beads, and works all ready beads for that selected matter.

title: Update auto-loop scheduler to run matter-scoped bead batches
description: Change autonomous run prompt selection from open-ended company prompt toward selecting the next actionable matter/frontier, reconciling that matter into ready beads, and assigning the whole ready bead batch for that matter to the run.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduler can compute/select an actionable matter via matters unlock/frontier, reconcile that matter into beads, read bd ready --json, select all ready non-epic beads supporting the selected matter, include each bead's acceptance criteria in a matter-scoped batch prompt, and preserve current loop behavior when no actionable matter or bead batch exists.
notes: Updated `scripts/core/auto-loop.sh` to reconcile the next actionable matter, select ready supporting beads as a batch, inject a bounded Matter-Scoped Batch prompt, and fall back cleanly when no batch exists. Verification: `python3 scripts/core/reconcile-matters-beads.py --json`, `uv run --with pytest python -m pytest`, `bash -n scripts/core/*.sh scripts/macos/*.sh scripts/wsl/*.sh`, `make help`.
close_reason: Auto-loop now scopes cycles to ready bead batches for the selected matter

acceptance_criteria: Renderer produces the existing consensus.md shape or a clearly compatible briefing; generated output is deterministic; source of truth is not consensus.md.
notes: Implemented `.matters/auto-company.json`, `scripts/core/matters_beads.py`, and `scripts/core/render-consensus.py` so `memories/consensus.md` is generated from authoritative Matters + Beads state. Verification: `python3 scripts/core/render-consensus.py --output memories/consensus.md`, `uv run --with pytest python -m pytest`, `bash -n scripts/core/*.sh scripts/macos/*.sh scripts/wsl/*.sh`, `make help`.
close_reason: Generated consensus briefing now renders from Matters + Beads state

title: Implement matters-to-beads reconciler guardrail
description: Create the smallest reconciler that maps false actionable matter conditions to beads and prevents worker agents from declaring strategic progress directly.
acceptance_criteria: Reconciler creates or updates beads for actionable false conditions; Matters updates require evidence; worker task flow documents that agents update Beads only.
notes: Added `scripts/core/reconcile-matters-beads.py` plus metadata-backed bead reconciliation in `scripts/core/matters_beads.py`. Worker flow now instructs agents to update Beads only, and the reviewer set the three migration conditions true in `.matters/auto-company.json` only after running verification.
close_reason: Reconciler now maps matter conditions to beads and reviewer-gates Matter truth
